{{Quote|A shape! I've thrown a shape! I've invented form! I've invented mass! Oh, cleverest Tilotny!|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
'''Tilotny''' was one of the non-corporeal [[Bedlam Spirits|spirits]] that inhabited a region near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]] and the first of her kind to take on a shape as they experimented with [[Time/Legends|time]] and [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tilotny and three other spirits met [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who was [[Mission to Bedlam|forced]] to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]] while running from three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Believing that she had invented form, Tilotny claimed she had created the beings, and decided to play with them, inadvertently [[Death/Legends|killing]] them in the process. After tiring of her playthings, she left, leaving her fellow spirit [[Splendid Ap]] to clean up the mess. Splendid Ap revived Organa and the stormtroopers but accidentally [[Time travel/Legends|transported]] the latter 8,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the past.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Everything has edges! And&hellip;and things happen one after another! Time! Tilotny has invented time! This is a novelty. This is a first thing!|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
[[File:Tilotny-CSWD2.png|thumb|left|250px|Tilotny takes physical form.]]
The omnipotent, transdimensional being known as Tilotny was one of the [[Bedlam Spirits]] who existed in the stark whiteness that digested [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]].<ref name="TEA" /> Generally abstract, non-corporeal beings, Tilotny and her cohorts began experimenting with [[Time/Legends|time]], matter, and [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and, at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tilotny took on a shape and form for the first time, materializing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]] in a form resembling a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Although Tilotny was the first of her kind to take on a form, it was not long before other Bedlam Spirits replicated her achievement and [[Horliss-Horliss]], [[Cold Danda Sine]], and [[Splendid Ap]] soon joined her on the planet, annoying Tilotny and making her feel less special. Believing herself to have invented form, time, mass, and edges, Tilotny gladly took credit for creating the world around them when asked by Cold Danda Sine, though Horliss-Horliss wondered if it had already taken shape before their arrival.<ref name="TTaS" />

As the group discussed their new forms and surroundings, they met [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who had been forced to land on the planet and was being [[Mission to Bedlam|pursued]] by three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Tilotny claimed to have created Organa too, causing Horliss-Horliss and Cold Danda Sine to insult Tilotny for how Organa looked, but Tilotny maintained that Organa was more elegant than Horliss-Horliss's null inversions or Danda's anti-concepts. When the stormtroopers arrived moments later, she was mocked by Cold Danda Sine for repeating a shape. Hoping to correct her apparent mistake, Tilotny used her powers to alter the form of one of the stormtroopers, crystallizing and inadvertently [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]. Horliss-Horliss was unimpressed by Tilotny's lack of subtlety and tried his own modification, killing Organa in a less obvious way by turning her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] into [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] while leaving the rest of her the same. Tilotny attempted once more to modify the beings, merging the two remaining stormtroopers into a single mass of writhing [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] that did not live long.<ref name="TTaS" /> 

Cold Danda Sine soon tired of the activity, however, and suggested that it was time to leave. Tilotny agreed, but Horliss-Horliss felt that, since Tilotny was the first to take shape, she should clean up the mess they had made of Organa and the stormtroopers. Tilotny refused, however, and instead instructed Splendid Ap to do so while she departed with the others. Splendid Ap restored the beings to life and their original forms, but unwittingly [[Time travel/Legends|sent]] the stormtroopers 8,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the past.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Tilotny will not tidy up. Let Splendid Ap, who is stupid, correct the disorder.|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
[[File:OrganaBedlamSpirits-TilotnyThrowsAShape.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Bedlam Spirits encounter Leia Organa.]]
Although she was an omnipotent being,<ref name="TEA" /> Tilotny was naive on matters of time and space.<ref name="TTaS" /> She had an innocent, bubbly manner<ref name="CSWE" /> and saw her life-threatening experiments with the beings she encountered as little more than a game. The first of her kind to take on a physical form, Tilotny believed herself to have invented form, mass, and time and credited herself with creating the world around her and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient beings]] she encountered, refusing to believe that any forms could have existed before her. She was extremely proud of her achievement and felt that the newness of form was spoiled when her fellow spirits learned how to take shapes of their own, accusing them of copying her and looking down on the indistinct shape taken by Horliss-Horliss. However, Horliss-Horliss believed she was boastful, jealous, and shallow and could not understand the subtlety of the form he gave himself compared to her form, though admitted she was clever to think of giving herself a shape first.<ref name="TTaS" />

When the others accused her of creating duplicate shapes upon seeing the stormtroopers, Tilotny blamed her apparent error on being distracted by her companions and, ashamed, attempted to correct her mistake, accidentally causing the deaths of Organa and the troopers. Tilotny, like the other Bedlam Spirits, soon lost interest in her playthings and decided to leave, refusing even to restore them to their previous state first. In her corporeal form, Tilotny resembled a Human female. Much larger than a real Human like Organa, she had [[Color/Legends|green]] features, pale green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and long, waving green [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|floated]] above the surface of the planet.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Nothing was before Tilotny made it be! How can shapes have shaped themselves without Tilotny?|Tilotny|<ref name="TTaS" />}}
Tilotny was an omnipotent being<ref name="TEA" /> whose powers allowed her to casually manipulate time and mass. An abstract entity by nature, she had the power to take on a physical form of her own and was the first of her kind to discover how to do so. When in corporeal form, she was capable of levitating above the ground. Tilotny was also capable of altering the forms of those she encountered. She did not fully understand the extent of her powers or the consequences of her abilities, however. Assuming that she had created the stormtroopers she encountered, she attempted to modify them, but caused their deaths in the process.<ref name="TTaS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tilotny was created by [[Alan Moore]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]'', which was published in the [[Marvel Comics]] UK comic book [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 154]]<ref name="TOS">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090309.html|text=The ''Star Wars'' EU/ ''Watchmen'' Connection}}</ref> in [[February]] [[1982]]. ''Tilotny Throws a Shape'' was illustrated by [[John Stokes]] and was originally published in black and white.<ref name="ESBM154">[[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 154]]</ref> It was later colored<ref name="CSW:D2">[[Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds 2|''Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds'' 2]]</ref> when reprinted by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds 2|''Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds'' 2]],<ref name="TOS" /> released [[September 18]], [[1996]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53776/classic_star_wars_devilworlds_1996_2|text=Classic Star Wars: Devilworlds (1996) #2}}</ref> giving Tilotny her green appearance.<ref name="CSW:D2" />

The character's entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that Tilotny existed near the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]],<ref name="TEA" /> but this was changed to the Bedlam Pulsar in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which also established Tilotny's species as a Bedlam Spirit.<ref name="CSWE" /> Whereas the original comic shows Splendid Ap resurrecting Organa and the stormtroopers after Tilotny refuses,<ref name="TTaS" /> ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' incorrectly states that Tilotny restored the beings.<ref name="CSWE" /> The error was acknowledged by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] during a [[The ForceCast|ForceCast]] interview in late 2008.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|pablog|146|What I meant to Say on the Forcecast&hellip;}}</ref>
